programmes.name_local: Altersrente der AHV / Rent de vieillesse AVS
programmes.amount_note: Min CHF 1'260 / max CHF 2'520 per month for a full pension (2025); married couples max CHF 3'780. New from 2026: 13th monthly pension payment. Amount depends on contribution years and average income.
programmes.deadline_note: Register at your Ausgleichskasse at least 3 months before reaching reference age (65; transitional rules for women born 1961-1969)

procedure_steps.detail: Request a pension application form from your cantonal Ausgleichskasse or via AHVeasy online
Submit the signed form with civil status documents
Ausgleichskasse calculates the pension from your individual account (IK) and pays monthly

programmes.source_snippet: Altersrente: 1'260.- im Minimum, 2'520.- im Maximum (Rentenbetrag mit voller Beitragsdauer in Franken pro Monat)

programmes.name_local: Invalidenrente der IV / Rente d'invalidité AI
programmes.amount_note: Full pension CHF 1'260-2'520/month (2025) at 100% invalidity; quarter (25-39% IV degree), half (40-49%) and three-quarter (50-59%) pensions are paid proportionally. Reintegration measures take priority over pensions.
programmes.deadline_note: Register at the IV-Stelle of your canton as early as possible after the health impairment

procedure_steps.detail: Register with the cantonal IV-Stelle (online or form)
IV-Stelle assesses medical situation and reintegration potential
After one year of incapacity, decision on pension degree and amount

programmes.source_snippet: Die Mindestrente der AHV sowie der IV steigt von 1225 auf 1260 Franken pro Monat, die Maximalrente von 2450 auf 2520 Franken

programmes.name_local: Witwen-, Witwer- und Zusatzrente der AHV
programmes.amount_note: Widow's/widower's pension 80% of the deceased's pension: CHF 1'008-2'016/month (2025). Zusatzrente for widowers with children. Conditions apply (children, marriage duration, age).

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at the Ausgleichskasse after the death of the spouse

programmes.source_snippet: Witwen- oder Witwerrente: 1'008.- im Minimum, 2'016.- im Maximum

programmes.amount_note: CHF 504-1'008/month (2025): orphan's pension after death of a parent; child pension (40% of pension) for pensioners with children under 18 (25 if in education).

procedure_steps.detail: Usually granted automatically together with the parent's pension or after a death is reported

documents_required.doc: Proof of education if child is over 18

programmes.source_snippet: Kinder- bzw. Waisenrente: 504.- im Minimum, 1'008.- im Maximum

programmes.amount_note: Annual EL equals the gap between recognised expenses and countable income. Recognised living-need lump sums 2025: CHF 20'670 (single), CHF 31'005 (couples); plus rent ceilings (max CHF 18'900/year in large centres) and health insurance premiums. Wealth limits: CHF 100'000 single / CHF 200'000 couples.

procedure_steps.detail: Fill in the EL application form (EL01) online or on paper at your cantonal Ausgleichskasse
Attach income, asset, rent and health premium evidence
Ausgleichskasse calculates annual EL and pays monthly

eligibility.income_note: Income- and asset-tested, but no single published ceiling: annual EL = recognised expenses minus countable income. Indicative maximum countable income for a single person living at home ~CHF 43'170/year (living-need lump sum CHF 20'670 + max rent CHF 18'900 + ~CHF 3'600 health premiums, 2025); for couples ~CHF 57'100 (CHF 31'005 + CHF 18'900 + ~CHF 7'200). Wealth limits: CHF 100'000 single / CHF 200'000 couple.

programmes.source_snippet: Der jährliche Pauschalbetrag für die Deckung des allgemeinen Lebensbedarfs wird für Alleinstehende auf 20 670 Franken erhöht; für Ehepaare auf 31 005 Franken

programmes.name_local: EL: Vergütung von Krankheits- und Behinderungskosten
programmes.name_en: EL coverage of illness and disability costs
programmes.amount_note: Within the EL system, uncovered illness and disability costs (e.g. dental treatment, care, Spitex contributions, aids) are reimbursed up to cantonal ceilings for EL recipients.
programmes.deadline_note: Costs must generally be claimed within a set period after they arise; check cantonal deadlines

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the cost claim with invoices to your cantonal Ausgleichskasse

eligibility.income_note: Same means test as Ergänzungsleistungen: recognised expenses (incl. illness/disability costs) must exceed countable income. Indicative max income single at home ~CHF 43'170/year (see EL record); wealth limits CHF 100'000 single / CHF 200'000 couple.

programmes.source_snippet: Bei den EL-Ausgaben wird unterschieden zwischen jährlichen Ergänzungsleistungen und der Vergütung von Krankheits- und Behinderungskosten

programmes.amount_note: CHF 252 (mild), CHF 630 (moderate), CHF 1'008 (severe) per month (2025) for AHV pensioners who permanently need help with everyday activities; granted regardless of income and assets.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the application for helplessness allowance to your Ausgleichskasse
Medical assessment determines the degree of helplessness

programmes.source_snippet: Hilflosenentschädigung: 252.- leichten Grades, 630.- mittleren Grades, 1'008.- schweren Grades

programmes.amount_note: Monthly allowance graded by degree of helplessness for IV pension recipients living at home or in institutions; minors may also qualify. Amounts follow the annual AHV/IV scale.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via the cantonal IV-Stelle

programmes.source_snippet: Hilflosenentschädigungen der AHV und der IV sind für Rentenbezüger bestimmt, die auf Dritthilfe angewiesen sind; die Höhe hängt vom Grad der Hilflosigkeit ab

programmes.amount_note: Hourly contribution for people with IV helplessness allowance who employ personal assistants: 2025 CHF 35.30 per hour, CHF 169.10 per night; paid monthly based on reported hours.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at the IV-Stelle with an assistance need assessment
Conclude an employment contract with the assistant and report hours monthly

programmes.source_snippet: In der IV beträgt der Assistenzbeitrag neu 35.30 Franken pro Stunde (+1 Fr.) und 169.10 Franken pro Nacht (+4.65 Fr.)

programmes.amount_note: Free vocational measures: job coaching, retraining and further training financing, trial work placements, and daily allowances during measures; takes priority over IV pensions.

procedure_steps.detail: Register with your cantonal IV-Stelle
Career assessment and individual reintegration plan

programmes.source_snippet: Eingliederung vor Rente: Die IV unterstützt berufliche Eingliederungsmassnahmen wie Umschulung, Weiterbildung und Arbeitsversuche

programmes.amount_note: IV pays for simple, robust assistive devices (wheelchairs, hearing aids, prostheses, etc.) from its approved lists; AHV covers certain aids for old-age pensioners.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via the IV-Stelle with a medical prescription

programmes.source_snippet: Die AHV finanziert auch eine Reihe von Hilfsmitteln für Altersrentner, wie z.B. Prothesen, Hörgeräte oder orthopädische Massschuhe

programmes.name_local: Überbrückungsleistungen für ältere Arbeitslose (ÜL) / Allocations de transition
programmes.amount_note: Income-tested benefit bridging the gap between exhaustion of unemployment benefit and AHV reference age for long-term unemployed aged roughly 60+; calculation follows the EL rules (living need, rent ceilings).

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at your RAV / cantonal Ausgleichskasse before ALV entitlement expires

eligibility.income_note: Income and asset tested, similar to EL

programmes.source_snippet: Überbrückungsleistungen (ÜL) sichern älteren ausgesteuerten Arbeitslosen das Existenzminimum bis zum Referenzalter

programmes.amount_note: 80% of average pre-birth income, max CHF 220/day, for 14 weeks (98 days); extendable up to 154 days if the newborn stays in hospital over 2 weeks.

procedure_steps.detail: Inform your employer; they register the claim with the Ausgleichskasse (self-employed: register yourself)
Allowance paid during the 14-week leave starting on the day of birth

programmes.source_snippet: Die Entschädigung beträgt 80 Prozent des durchschnittlichen Erwerbseinkommens vor der Geburt (max. 220 Franken pro Tag). Der Mutterschaftsurlaub muss unmittelbar nach der Geburt und am Stück bezogen werden (14 Wochen).

programmes.name_local: Urlaub des andern Elternteils (Vaterschaftsurlaub, EO) / Congé de paternité
programmes.amount_note: 80% of average income, max CHF 220/day, for 2 weeks (14 daily allowances); to be taken within 6 months of the birth, in one block or by day (10 working days).
programmes.deadline_note: Leave must be taken within 6 months after the birth

procedure_steps.detail: Notify the employer and take the 2 weeks within 6 months
Employer registers the claim with the Ausgleichskasse

programmes.source_snippet: Erwerbstätige Väter haben nach der Geburt ihres Kindes Anspruch auf einen Urlaub von 2 Wochen, der über die EO entschädigt wird. Der Vaterschaftsurlaub muss innert 6 Monaten nach der Geburt bezogen werden.

programmes.amount_note: 80% of average income, max CHF 220/day, for 2 weeks of paid leave when adopting a child under 4; parents can share the leave freely within 12 months.
programmes.deadline_note: Leave must be taken within 12 months of the child joining the household

procedure_steps.detail: Register with the Ausgleichskasse after the adoption placement

programmes.source_snippet: Erwerbstätige Eltern, die ein Kind unter 4 Jahren adoptieren, haben Anspruch auf einen bezahlten Adoptionsurlaub von 2 Wochen, den sie frei unter sich aufteilen können.

programmes.name_local: Betreuungsentschädigung für Eltern (BUE) / Allocation pour soins
programmes.name_en: Care leave allowance for parents of seriously ill children (EO)
programmes.amount_note: 80% of average income, max CHF 220/day, up to 14 weeks (98 daily allowances) within an 18-month framework period, for parents who must stop working to care for a seriously health-impaired child under 18.
programmes.deadline_note: 98 daily allowances must be used within an 18-month framework period

procedure_steps.detail: Obtain a medical certificate confirming the child's serious health impairment
Employer (or self-employed person) registers with the Ausgleichskasse

documents_required.doc: Medical certificate of serious health impairment

programmes.source_snippet: Für die Betreuung eines gesundheitlich schwer beeinträchtigten Kindes haben berufstätige Eltern das Recht auf einen 14-wöchigen bezahlten Urlaub. Die Betreuungs-Entschädigung entspricht 80 % des durchschnittlichen Lohns.

programmes.name_local: Erwerbsersatz für Dienstleistende (Militär, Zivildienst, Zivilschutz) / APG
programmes.name_en: Income replacement for military, civilian service and civil protection (EO)
programmes.amount_note: 80% of average pre-service income (max CHF 220/day) for employed persons; minimum daily allowance CHF 69, for non-employed CHF 62; plus child allowance CHF 20/day per child.
programmes.deadline_note: Claims can be filed during service; employer usually continues salary and receives the EO

procedure_steps.detail: Fill in the EO registration form (paper or online) during/after service
Ausgleichskasse pays employer (if salary continued) or the service member directly

programmes.source_snippet: Erwerbsersatz für Dienstleistende (EO): Entschädigung von 80 Prozent des Erwerbseinkommens für Personen in Militär-, Zivildienst- oder Zivilschutzdienst

programmes.amount_note: 70% of insured salary (80% with child maintenance obligations or insured salary below CHF 3'797). Insured salary capped at CHF 12'350/month. 200-520 daily allowances within a 2-year framework period depending on age and contribution record.
programmes.deadline_note: Register with the RAV from the first day of unemployment; late registration reduces entitlement

procedure_steps.detail: Register as a jobseeker at your regional employment centre (RAV)
Choose an unemployment fund (Arbeitslosenkasse) and submit salary documents
Attend monthly RAV counselling and prove active job search

programmes.source_snippet: Ihre Arbeitslosenentschädigung entspricht grundsätzlich 70% Ihres versicherten Verdienstes oder 80% bei einer Unterhaltspflicht gegenüber Kindern unter 25 Jahren. Der maximale Betrag liegt bei CHF 12350.

programmes.amount_note: 80% of the lost salary for the hours not worked, for a limited accounting period; requires prior authorisation by the cantonal office and written employee consent.
programmes.deadline_note: Employer must obtain pre-notice authorisation from the canton before short-time work starts

procedure_steps.detail: Employer notifies the cantonal authority of planned short-time work
Employees give written consent; KAE paid via employer through the unemployment fund

programmes.source_snippet: Während der Kurzarbeit erhalten Arbeitnehmende eine Kurzarbeitsentschädigung von 80% des wegfallenden Lohns

programmes.name_local: Insolvenzentschädigung der ALV / Indemnité en cas d'insolvabilité
programmes.amount_note: Covers up to 4 months of unpaid salary claims (capped at the insured salary ceiling) when the employer becomes insolvent or bankruptcy is closed for lack of assets.

procedure_steps.detail: File the claim with the unemployment fund after the insolvency decision

documents_required.doc: Proof of salary claims (employment contract, payslips)

programmes.source_snippet: Die Insolvenzentschädigung deckt Lohnausfälle von bis zu vier Monaten bei Zahlungsunfähigkeit des Arbeitgebers

programmes.name_local: Schlechtwetterentschädigung der ALV / Indemnité en cas d'intempéries
programmes.amount_note: 80% of the lost salary for weather-related work stoppages in exposed sectors (mainly construction, winter season), paid via the employer.

procedure_steps.detail: Employer registers bad-weather losses with the unemployment fund within the set deadline

programmes.source_snippet: Die Schlechtwetterentschädigung beträgt 80 Prozent des wegfallenden Lohns bei witterungsbedingten Arbeitsausfällen

programmes.amount_note: Free courses, employment programmes and temporary employment subsidies for registered jobseekers; course costs and daily allowances covered by ALV.

procedure_steps.detail: Discuss measures with your RAV counsellor; participation can be assigned

programmes.source_snippet: Das RAV kann arbeitslosen Personen Kurse, Beschäftigungsprogramme und Zwischenverdienstmöglichkeiten zuweisen

programmes.name_local: Kostenlose Arbeitsvermittlung und Beratung durch das RAV / ORP
programmes.amount_note: Free job placement, career counselling, vacancy access and coaching for all jobseekers registered with the RAV; no charge for services.

procedure_steps.detail: Register online or in person at your RAV

programmes.source_snippet: Die regionalen Arbeitsvermittlungszentren (RAV) beraten Stellensuchende kostenlos und unterstützen sie bei der Stellensuche

programmes.amount_note: Federal minimum CHF 215/month per child aged 0-16 (2025). Many cantons pay more (e.g. higher amounts in Romandy). Paid via employer (employees) or the cantonal family compensation fund (self-employed, non-employed).

procedure_steps.detail: Employees: apply through your employer; self-employed/non-employed: apply at the cantonal Familienausgleichskasse

documents_required.doc: Application form of the family compensation fund

programmes.source_snippet: Die Kinderzulage stieg von 200 auf 215 Franken pro Monat. Es handelt sich um Mindestansätze, die Kantone können auch höhere Zulagen festlegen

programmes.amount_note: Federal minimum CHF 268/month (2025) per child aged 16-25 in education; cantons may pay more. Paid instead of the child allowance while the child is in initial education.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via employer or cantonal family compensation fund with proof of education

programmes.source_snippet: Die Ausbildungszulage stieg von 250 auf 268 Franken pro Monat (Mindestansatz, Kantone können mehr festlegen)

programmes.amount_note: Child and education allowances for persons working in agriculture (farmers and agricultural employees); amounts fixed federally (LKG).

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via the agricultural Ausgleichskasse (LWK)

programmes.source_snippet: Merkblatt 6.09 - Familienzulagen in der Landwirtschaft (FamZ, FLG)

programmes.amount_note: One-off birth or adoption allowance in the cantons that provide one (e.g. Valais, Fribourg, Vaud, Geneva, Jura, Neuchâtel); amount and conditions set by cantonal law.
programmes.deadline_note: Often must be claimed within a limited period after birth/adoption (cantonal deadline)

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at your cantonal family compensation fund after the birth/adoption

programmes.source_snippet: Einige Kantone kennen zusätzlich einmalige Geburts- oder Adoptionszulagen aus der Familienausgleichskasse

programmes.amount_note: The canton or municipality advances unpaid child maintenance and recovers it from the defaulting parent. Cantonal caps apply (e.g. Zurich: up to the simple orphan's/child pension, currently CHF 1'008/month per child). Free for minors' maintenance in all cantons.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at the maintenance advance office of your canton/municipality with the enforceable maintenance title
Office pays the advance monthly and pursues recovery from the liable parent

documents_required.doc: Enforceable maintenance title (judgment or approved agreement)
Income and asset evidence (means test in most cantons)

eligibility.income_note: Income- and asset-tested, but most cantons publish no single income ceiling. Zurich (AlimV): advance only if recognised living costs exceed countable income of the household; wealth limits CHF 40'300-120'800 depending on household + CHF 30'200 per additional child; max advance CHF 1'008/month per child. Some cantons (AI, AR, NW, OW, SZ, UR) use EL-type tests; Ticino pays advances regardless of means. Thresholds vary by canton.

programmes.source_snippet: Bevorschusst werden Unterhaltsbeiträge gemäss dem Urteil oder dem Vertrag. Die maximale Höhe des Vorschusses ist die einer einfachen Waisen- und Kinderrente (gegenwärtig 1008 Franken pro Monat).

programmes.name_local: Individuelle Prämienverbilligung (IPV) / Réduction individuelle des primes (RIP)
programmes.amount_note: Income- and asset-tested subsidy towards compulsory health insurance premiums; paid to the insurer directly. Systems and thresholds differ by canton (in Zurich, the canton pays the premium share above an income-dependent own contribution).
programmes.deadline_note: Apply annually; some cantons grant automatically via tax data, others require an application

procedure_steps.detail: In Zurich the SVA Zürich semi-automatically identifies entitled persons from tax data and sends pre-filled forms; if you receive none by April, file the online Nachmeldung yourself (deadline 31 March of the following year); other cantons require an annual application
Submit the application (often automatic for existing recipients)
Subsidy is paid directly to your health insurer, reducing your premium invoice

eligibility.income_note: VARIES BY CANTON. Reference Zurich 2026: families with only minor children qualify for the minimum premium reduction (children's premiums cut by >=80%) up to a massgebendes Einkommen of CHF 70'500/year; families with a young adult in education up to CHF 94'000. Single adults: no fixed ceiling; effective cut-off depends on premium region (Stadt Zürich, Region 1, approx. CHF 57'000 for 18-25 y.o. and CHF 78'600 over 25). Asset limits Zurich: CHF 150'000 single / CHF 300'000 married or single parents. Other cantons use different thresholds (e.g. Ticino RIPAM, Genève RDU groups).

programmes.source_snippet: Den Rest der Prämie – die individuelle Prämienverbilligung – übernimmt der Kanton. Je weniger Einkommen und Vermögen jemand hat, desto mehr Unterstützung bekommt sie oder er.

programmes.amount_note: Mandatory basic insurance for all residents covering outpatient and inpatient treatment, maternity, medicines and certain prevention; insured persons pay premiums, franchise and 10% retention (max CHF 700/year adults, CHF 350 children).
programmes.deadline_note: New residents must join an insurer within 3 months

procedure_steps.detail: Choose a health insurer and conclude basic insurance within 3 months of arrival/birth

programmes.source_snippet: Die obligatorische Krankenpflegeversicherung deckt die Kosten für die Behandlung bei Krankheit, Mutterschaft und Unfall für alle in der Schweiz wohnhaften Personen

programmes.amount_note: Subsidiary minimum-income benefit covering the basic living need (SKOS guideline: Grundbedarf for a single person about CHF 1'000/month), housing costs up to cantonal ceilings and basic health insurance premiums. Assets and income are fully counted; repayment may be required in some cantons.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at the Sozialamt of your municipality of residence
Means assessment of income, assets and expenses
Monthly payment plus integration/counselling support

eligibility.income_note: Needs-based: social assistance covers the gap between the SKOS budget and household income. Proxy reference: SKOS basic living allowance (Grundbedarf) 2025 CHF 1'052/month single = CHF 12'624/year, plus recognised rent and health insurance premiums; households with income below their full SKOS budget qualify. Guidelines: SKOS-Richtlinien.

programmes.source_snippet: Die Sozialhilfe sichert das Existenzminimum, wenn eigene Mittel und vorrangige Leistungen nicht ausreichen (SKOS-Richtlinien)

programmes.name_local: Sozialhilfe im Asylbereich / Aide sociale dans le domaine de l'asile
programmes.amount_note: Reduced-rate social assistance for asylum seekers, temporarily admitted persons and protection status S during the first years of residence; administered by cantons with federal funding.

procedure_steps.detail: Assigned and paid automatically through the cantonal asylum/social authority after registration

eligibility.income_note: Needs-based by definition (persons in the asylum process without sufficient means); asylum assistance rates are below SKOS social assistance budgets; no income ceiling figure published.

programmes.source_snippet: Asylsuchende, vorläufig Aufgenommene und Schutzbedürftige erhalten Sozialhilfe im Asylbereich nach den kantonalen Ansätzen

programmes.name_local: Wohneigentumsförderung der Kantone / Encouragement cantonal à la propriété du logement
programmes.amount_note: Cantonal grants or low-interest loans for low- and middle-income households to buy or build an owner-occupied home (e.g. Zurich Wohneigentumsförderung, Bern Wohnbauförderung); income and asset limits apply.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply before signing the purchase/building contract (cantonal rules)

procedure_steps.detail: Check eligibility and apply at your canton's housing office before purchase/construction

eligibility.income_note: Where offered, income- and asset-tested with canton-specific ceilings (e.g. max taxable income/wealth, owner-occupation condition); several cantons (incl. Zürich) have abolished WEF; thresholds vary by canton.

programmes.source_snippet: Mehrere Kantone fördern den Erwerb von selbstbewohntem Wohneigentum durch Beiträge oder verbilligte Darlehen für Haushalte in bescheidenen wirtschaftlichen Verhältnissen

programmes.amount_note: Municipal and cooperatively subsidised flats let below market rent to eligible households; income limits apply and applications run via the city's housing register.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the city's housing portal (Wohnungsregister)
Apply for advertised subsidised flats with income evidence

eligibility.income_note: Subsidised flats: taxable household income ceiling (canton ZH Wohnbauförderung framework) 1 person CHF 49'600 / 2+ persons CHF 58'500 (2020 values, indexed annually per 1 July); taxable wealth max CHF 200'000; min. 2 years' residence in canton Zürich.

programmes.source_snippet: Die Stadt Zürich und gemeinnützige Wohnbauträger vermieten kostengünstige Wohnungen an Haushalte mit beschränktem Einkommen

programmes.name_local: Das Gebäudeprogramm (Bund und Kantone) / Programme Bâtiments
programmes.funder: Bund und Kantone (finanziert aus der CO2-Abgabe)
programmes.amount_note: Subsidies for energy-efficient renovation: insulation of the building envelope, replacement of fossil heating with heat pumps/district heating/wood, and other efficiency measures; cantonal application offices, funded from the CO2 levy.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply BEFORE starting the renovation works (cantonal rule)

procedure_steps.detail: Check your canton's programme and submit the application before works begin
After completion, submit invoices and evidence for payment

programmes.source_snippet: Das Gebäudeprogramm fördert die energetische Gebäudesanierung - Wärmedämmung der Gebäudehülle und Ersatz fossiler Heizungen - finanziert aus der CO2-Abgabe

programmes.amount_note: One-off grant of roughly CHF 355/kWp for small installations (2026 values), covering around 20-30% of reference investment costs: KLEIV (<100 kW), GREIV (>=100 kW), HEIV (full feed-in, up to 60%).
programmes.deadline_note: Submit via the Pronovo customer portal after commissioning (GREIV can be filed earlier)

procedure_steps.detail: Create an account in the Pronovo customer portal and file the EIV application
Grid operator/auditor certifies the installation data; Pronovo decides and pays

programmes.source_snippet: Die Einmalvergütung setzt sich aus einem Grundbeitrag und einem Leistungsbeitrag (abhängig von der Leistung der Anlage) zusammen

programmes.name_en: Feed-in remuneration / sliding market premium (large renewables)
programmes.amount_note: Feed-in remuneration at reference tariffs for existing KEV/EVS plants and a sliding market premium for large installations (>=150 kW, awarded via auctions) producing renewable electricity.
programmes.deadline_note: Auction windows for large installations announced by Pronovo/BFE

procedure_steps.detail: Register the installation and remuneration claim with Pronovo

programmes.source_snippet: Pronovo ist für das Inkasso des Netzzuschlags, die Ausstellung von Herkunftsnachweisen und die Abwicklung der Förderprogramme des Bundes für die Stromproduktion aus neuen erneuerbaren Energien zuständig

programmes.name_local: Rückverteilung der CO2-Abgabe an die Bevölkerung
programmes.name_en: CO2 levy redistribution to the population
programmes.amount_note: Two thirds of the CO2 levy on fuels is redistributed equally to all residents as an automatic deduction on the health insurance premium bill (amount varies by year, recently around CHF 80-90 per person).

procedure_steps.detail: Automatic: appears as a credit on your compulsory health insurance premium invoice

programmes.source_snippet: Zwei Drittel der Einnahmen aus der CO2-Abgabe werden über die Krankenkassen an die Bevölkerung zurückerstattet

programmes.name_local: Kantonale Stipendien und Darlehen / Bourses et prêts d'études cantonaux
programmes.amount_note: Income-tested grants (Stipendien, non-repayable) and interest-free loans (Darlehen) for upper-secondary and tertiary education; computed from training and living costs minus own/parental means. In Zurich, apply by 31 July (autumn) / 31 January (spring) for full entitlement.
programmes.deadline_note: E.g. Zurich: 31 July for autumn semester, 31 January for spring semester; late applications reduced

procedure_steps.detail: Estimate entitlement with the canton's scholarship calculator
Submit the application online with income evidence before the deadline
Decision by decree; paid in two instalments

documents_required.doc: Parents'/own tax assessment and income proof

eligibility.income_note: Income-tested via the deficit principle (Fehlbetragsdeckung): stipend = recognised education/living costs minus own and parents' expected contribution; cantons publish no single income ceiling. Parental income/wealth scales, cost budgets and loan shares vary by canton (EDK model law as reference).

programmes.source_snippet: Stipendienrechtlicher Wohnsitz im Kanton Zürich; finanzielle Verhältnisse reichen nicht aus, um die Ausbildungs- und Lebenshaltungskosten zu finanzieren

programmes.amount_note: Complementary municipal scholarships for city residents (min. 2 years' residence): living-cost supplements (CHF 100/month aged 18-24, CHF 150/month from 25), coverage of school costs and grants for adults gaining a first vocational qualification (up to age 60).

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at the city's scholarship office (usually after/parallel to the cantonal application)

eligibility.income_note: Income-tested via deficit principle against the city's published cost budgets; no single income ceiling - entitlement ends when family income covers the recognised budget.

programmes.source_snippet: Volljährige Personen erhalten Zusatzbeiträge für Wohnen/Leben in der Stadt Zürich: von 18 bis 24 Jahren: 100 Franken pro Monat; ab 25 Jahren: 150 Franken pro Monat

programmes.name_local: Bourses d'études du canton de Vaud (SCBE)
programmes.funder: Service de la formation post-obligatoire et des bourses d'études (VD)
programmes.amount_note: Means-tested cantonal grants and loans for Vaud-resident students in post-compulsory education; parental income considered for young students.
programmes.deadline_note: Annual application before the start of the academic year (cantonal deadline)

procedure_steps.detail: File the online scholarship application with the canton's bourses service

eligibility.income_note: Means-tested per LAEF barème (OCBE): recognised charges, training costs and parental income/fortune determine the deficit-based grant; no single income ceiling. Deadlines: 31 Aug (gymnase/apprentissage), 30 Sep (université/EPFL/HES).

programmes.source_snippet: Le canton de Vaud octroie des bourses et prêts d'études selon la situation financière de la famille

programmes.source_snippet: Der Kanton Zürich fördert die Bereitstellung von preisgünstigen Mietwohnungen für Personen mit geringem Einkommen und Vermögen.

programmes.funder: Bund (SECO) mit BG OST-SÜD, BG Mitte, Cautionnement romand, BG SAFFA
programmes.amount_note: Federally supported guarantee cooperatives guarantee SME bank loans up to CHF 1'000'000, easing access to credit for start-ups, investments and successions; the Confederation covers up to 65% of losses and part of administrative costs. SMEs pay an annual risk premium (~1.25%).

procedure_steps.detail: Submit a guarantee application to the cooperative responsible for your canton (BG OST-SÜD, BG Mitte, Cautionnement romand or BG SAFFA)
Personal interview and credit assessment with your bank
Guarantee contract between SME, cooperative and bank; loan is disbursed

eligibility.income_note: No income test; viability-based assessment of the SME.

programmes.source_snippet: Diese Genossenschaften bürgen für Kredite in Höhe von bis zu 1 Million Franken. Der Bund sichert ihr Verlustrisiko mit bis zu 65% ab.

programmes.name_en: SAFFA guarantee cooperative for women entrepreneurs
programmes.amount_note: Nationwide guarantee cooperative specifically for women entrepreneurs: guarantees bank loans up to CHF 1'000'000 for business foundings, takeovers and growth; part of the federally recognised SME guarantee system.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the guarantee application to BG SAFFA
Interview and review; upon approval the loan is issued via your bank

eligibility.income_note: No income test; business viability assessed.

programmes.source_snippet: BG SAFFA ... operates throughout Switzerland and focuses on women entrepreneurs.

programmes.name_local: Förderung der selbständigen Erwerbstätigkeit aus der Arbeitslosigkeit (ALV/RAV)
programmes.name_en: ALV support for starting a business while unemployed
programmes.amount_note: Unemployment insurance pays up to 90 daily allowances (~18 weeks) during a planning phase in which the unemployed person prepares self-employment full-time (exempt from job-search duties); free courses/coaching via the cantonal Fachstelle Selbständigkeit.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact your RAV and the cantonal Fachstelle Selbständigkeit before starting
Submit business concept; if approved, receive up to 90 daily allowances during planning (no operative activity allowed)
Decide definitively; upon start-up you are deregistered from the unemployment fund

eligibility.income_note: No income test; requires recognised ALV entitlement, age 20+, 100% work capacity and a viable business plan.

programmes.source_snippet: In der Planungsphase können Sie während maximal 18 Wochen (das entspricht 90 Taggeldern) Ihre Selbständigkeit vorbereiten.

programmes.amount_note: Under the federal law on the improvement of agricultural structures (RKG), farmers obtain subsidised loans/contributions: start-up aid for young farmers, credits for farm buildings, processing/storage facilities, ecological installations and operating-aid loans; administered by cantons (e.g. Bernische Stiftung für Agrarkredite).

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the application with project documents and accounts to the cantonal office (e.g. BAK Münsingen for Bern)

documents_required.doc: Accounts of the last 3 years and tax declaration

eligibility.income_note: No income test; viability/professional-farming criteria apply.

programmes.source_snippet: Starthilfe für Jungbäuerinnen und Jungbauern ... Investitionshilfen für Neubauten, Sanierungen und Erweiterungen von Ökonomiegebäuden ... Betriebshilfe-Darlehen

programmes.name_local: Abzug Krankheits- und Unfallkosten (direkte Bundessteuer und Kantone)
programmes.name_en: Tax deduction for illness and accident costs
programmes.amount_note: Self-paid medical, dental, pharmaceutical and care costs are deductible from taxable income insofar as they exceed 5% of net income (Art. 33 Abs. 1 Bst. h DBG); some cantons apply lower thresholds (SZ/GL 2%, SG/VS 0.5%, GE and BL none).
programmes.deadline_note: Declare with the annual tax return

procedure_steps.detail: List all self-paid illness/accident costs in the tax return and keep receipts

documents_required.doc: Medical invoices and insurer statements (on request)

eligibility.income_note: No income ceiling; deduction applies above a self-retention of 5% of net income (federal tax).

programmes.source_snippet: Krankheits- und Unfallkosten sind nur abziehbar, soweit sie einen Selbstbehalt von 5% des Reineinkommens übersteigen.

programmes.amount_note: Rescues ~16-35 tonnes of surplus food daily and distributes it free to over 500 social institutions and distribution points in 12 regions (soup kitchens, shelters, food points); individuals receive food via these partner institutions, not directly.

procedure_steps.detail: Approach a partner social institution or distribution point supplied by Schweizer Tafel

documents_required.doc: Registration/referral via the partner social institution

eligibility.income_note: For people affected by poverty; access via social institutions which assess need. No published income ceiling.

programmes.source_snippet: Die Schweizer Tafel rettet täglich einwandfreie Lebensmittel vor dem Abfall und verteilt sie an soziale Institutionen und Abgabestellen in der ganzen Schweiz.

programmes.amount_note: Distributes donated food at weekly distribution points across Switzerland to people in financial hardship; access requires a customer card (max 1 year) issued by recognised social services after a means check. Card also grants first-time access to Caritas-Märkte.
programmes.deadline_note: Customer card valid max 1 calendar year

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the social service assigned to your local distribution point for a means assessment
Receive the customer card and collect food weekly at the distribution point

documents_required.doc: Customer card issued by a recognised social service

eligibility.income_note: For people in financial hardship; the issuing social service checks financial circumstances (subsistence-level). No published income ceiling.

programmes.source_snippet: Die Kundenkarte wird ausschliesslich von privaten oder öffentlichen Sozialfachstellen ausgestellt. Diese prüfen die finanziellen Umstände der Betroffenen.

programmes.name_local: Pro Senectute - kostenlose Beratung und Finanzhilfen
programmes.name_en: Pro Senectute free advice and financial aid for the elderly
programmes.funder: Pro Senectute Schweiz (mit Bundesbeiträgen über AHV)
programmes.amount_note: Free, confidential advice for people 60+ and their relatives at over 100 centres (finances, pensions, EL claims, housing, care); individual financial aid in case of hardship; EL calculator and help asserting benefit claims.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the nearest Pro Senectute centre or infoline 058 591 15 15

eligibility.income_note: Advice is free for all aged 60+; financial aid is hardship-based with individual assessment, no published income ceiling.

programmes.source_snippet: Unsere Fachpersonen vor Ort beraten Sie kostenlos, vertraulich und kompetent zu Finanzen, Pensionierung, Gesundheit, Lebensgestaltung, persönlicher Vorsorge und Wohnen.

programmes.name_en: Victim support under the Victim Support Act (OHG)
programmes.amount_note: Free counselling, immediate and longer-term help (medical, psychological, legal) for victims of crimes against physical/sexual/psychological integrity and their relatives; plus compensation and satisfaction payments where the offender or insurance does not pay. No criminal complaint required.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the cantonal victim support centre (Beratungsstelle Opferhilfe)
Applications for compensation/satisfaction go to the authority of the canton where the crime occurred

documents_required.doc: Documentation of the crime and its consequences (medical/police records where available)

eligibility.income_note: Counselling and immediate help regardless of financial situation; longer-term help, compensation and advances depend on the applicant's financial circumstances (income limits described as generous; no single published ceiling).

programmes.source_snippet: Anspruch auf Opferhilfe hat jede Person, die durch eine Straftat in ihrer körperlichen, psychischen oder sexuellen Gesundheit direkt und schwer beeinträchtigt worden ist.

programmes.amount_note: Free HPV vaccination (Gardasil 9) for girls and boys / young women and men aged 11-26 resident in the canton, via school medical services and participating doctors; no deductible (franchise-free) when done within cantonal programmes.
programmes.deadline_note: First vaccination before the 27th birthday

procedure_steps.detail: Book via the school medical service or a doctor participating in the cantonal programme
2 doses if started before age 15, otherwise 3 doses

documents_required.doc: Residence in the canton; parental consent for minors

eligibility.income_note: No income test; free for all canton residents aged 11-26 within the programme.

programmes.source_snippet: Im Rahmen des kantonalen HPV-Impfprogramms ist die Impfung für diese Personengruppe kostenlos.
